test_title: PYST 22: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 19 Aug, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: In a row of 46 people facing the north, Lalita sits 17th from the left end. If only 15 people sit to the right of Damini, then how many people sit between Damini and Lalita?
solution:
Given:

Total people = 46

 
• All are facing north (so left → right is left end → right end)
 
• Lalita sits 17th from the left end.
 
• 15 people sit to the right of Damini.

 
• If 15 people are to the right of Damini,
 
• then Damini’s position from the **right end** is: 15+1=<s
